Build prompt

Build “Science Fair Judge Scoring Sheet” on NeoApps for a science fair coordinator. Give assigned judges a mobile rubric and combine submitted scores with configured weights. Use invitations and scope records to this group. Include a demo with fictional records.

Acceptance test

A project earning 4 of 5 on two equally weighted criteria totals 80%. Other judges’ drafts stay private.
